task_description.overview: Determine the lowest magnitude above which seismic events are reliably recorded using three statistical methods.
steps: Estimate Mc using the maximum curvature method via cat.estimate_mc_maxc(fmd_bin).
Estimate Mc using the b-stability method via cat.estimate_mc_b_stability().
Estimate Mc using the Kolmogorov–Smirnov test via cat.estimate_mc_ks().
Retrieve and compare the Catalog.mc property after each estimation.

task_definition.agent_prompt:
Estimate the magnitude of completeness for the given catalog: {catalog_path}. First, loading the catalog and bin the magnitude with delta_m=0.1. Then estimate the magnitude of completeness using: 1) maximum curvature (`cat.estimate_mc_maxc(fmd_bin={fmd_bin})`), 2) b-stability (`cat.estimate_mc_b_stability()`), and 3) KS test (`cat.estimate_mc_ks()`), separately. After each call, report the updated Catalog.mc value. Finally, figure the magnitude distribution with the estimated magnitude of completeness. 
 Note: 1) The `seismostats` libarary provide some functions to do catalog statistic analysis and ploting. Please refer to the `seismostats` provide some functions to assist. 
 2) Save the mc data to {result_data.save name} with content {result_data.content} and the mc plot to {result_plot}.
